scope: Twenty additions only: numeric10 + text/hash/geometry/terminal7 + network3; existing112 are not recounted.

measurement.source_scope: Uncompressed regular-file payload bytes in selected vendor trees, including retained notices/readme/tests where present; excludes shared extensions, generated build views, catalog documentation, downloaded archives and build products.
measurement.original_source_scope: Full upstream unpacked snapshots before selection, as recorded in component source-selection reports.
measurement.retained_source_verification: Recounted from current patch vendor trees and matched to component reports for all20.
measurement.binary_scope: Sum of selected static .a files, including archive/symbol-table overhead; neither executable size nor resident memory nor final linked kernel size.
measurement.binary_platform: Local Linux x86_64 C99 MinSizeRel profiles; exact profiles are in cited build reports. Other platforms NOT_RUN.
binary_exclusions: Existing LibTomMath dependency is not counted again.
Legacy xxHash implementation is not counted again.
Monolithic libevent.a is not added on top of core/extra/pthreads.
mDNS has no archive: 35640-byte consumer executable is reported separately, not added to archive total.
Shared libraries/system runtime, tools and final application linkage are not part of archive totals.
measurement.test_scope: Only selected reported C99 native checks passed. Upstream full suites, LMX wrapper execution and cross-platform execution are not claimed.
